name: CA-02
label: Safe D

key_factors: Incumbent Jared Huffman running with large cash advantage
Republican challenger has reported no fundraising
Prediction markets price Huffman near certain to win
model.rationale: Huffman holds a seat with a D+13 lean, has over $1 million on hand against a challenger with no reported fundraising, and markets price his reelection at roughly 96%. With no polls or expert ratings to contradict the fundamentals, this stays safely Democratic.
model.watch: Any late polling showing a competitive race or unexpected incumbent trouble would be the first sign of movement, but nothing currently suggests it.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Jared Huffman, the Democratic incumbent, is seeking another term in a northern California district that leans Democratic by about 13 points. He advanced to the general election and has built a substantial financial lead, with roughly $1 million on hand and no outside spending against him. Republican Robin Littau has reported no fundraising activity.

No public polls or expert ratings cover this race, so the outlook rests on district fundamentals, incumbency, and the money gap. Prediction markets give Huffman about a 96% chance of winning. The district's partisan lean and the challenger's lack of visible resources make an upset unlikely, and the race is rated safely Democratic.
